title: datura laevis
intro: Datura laevis, commonly known as White Angel Trumpet, is a plant species belonging to the Solanaceae family, native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic properties, which may aid in relieving pain and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of Datura laevis include alkaloids, such as scopolamine and hyoscyamine, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including sedation, pain relief, and anticholinergic effects. However, due to its toxicity, the plant should be handled with caution and only used under the guidance of a healthcare professional.
